topic: Buying Eggs at the Farmers Market

script.title: EGGS AT THE FARMERS MARKET

script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🥚市集買蛋英文｜詢問蛋價・半打與一打・現金或刷卡｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
一打雞蛋多少錢？半打又是多少？
攤位上只收現金，還是要怎麼刷卡？

這一集帶大家走進週日的農場市集，Frank 在蛋攤前從問價、比較蛋殼顏色、搞清楚半打份數，到現金與刷卡的選擇，一路都是輕鬆自然的美式口語。

你會聽到：
🥚 詢問價格與份數：例如「How much for a dozen eggs?」、「any half dozens here?」。
🐄 聊農場與新鮮度：例如「same farm, same week」、「fresh from Saturday morning」。
💵 付款與閒聊收尾：例如「do you take cards, or cash only?」、「here you go, have a great week」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

這個週末，帶一顆雞蛋的錢，去市集練一句英文吧！
script.thumbnail_action: holding an egg carton at the market stall
script.title_quote: how much for a dozen eggs

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! How much for a dozen eggs?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ haʊ mʌtʃ fɔːr ə ˈdʌzən ɛɡz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six for brown, eight for the blue ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks fɔːr braʊn eɪt fɔːr ðə bluː wʌnz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh, fancy blue? Are they fresher or just cute?
dialogue.phonetic: /uː ˈfænsi bluː ɑːr ðeɪ ˈfrɛʃər ər dʒʌst kjuːt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，高級藍？比較新鮮，還是單純可愛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, mostly cute. Same farm, same week.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈmoʊstli kjuːt seɪm fɑːrm seɪm wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，主要是可愛。同一座農場，同一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take brown then. Any half dozens here?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk braʊn ðɛn ˈɛni hæf ˈdʌzənz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 那我拿棕色的。這裡賣半打嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing, half a dozen runs four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr θɪŋ hæf ə ˈdʌzən rʌnz fɔːr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four? What happened to the six-dollar sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔːr wʌt həˈpænd tə ðə sɪks ˈdɑːlər saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 四塊？那六塊的牌子怎麼變了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain! Fewer eggs this month, prices moved up.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn ˈfjuːər ɛɡz ðɪs mʌnθ ˈpraɪsɪz muːvd ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 下雨啦！這個月蛋變少了，價格往上走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, nature wins. Two brown dozens, please then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑː ˈneɪtʃər wɪnz tuː braʊn ˈdʌzənz pliːz ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 啊，大自然贏了。那請給我兩打棕色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming right up. Fresh from Saturday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ raɪt ʌp frɛʃ frʌm ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 馬上來。星期六早上剛收的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Do you take cards, or cash only?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs duː ju teɪk kɑːrdz ər kæʃ ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 好。你們收卡，還是只收現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card's fine now, though cash is faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑːrdz faɪn naʊ ðoʊ kæʃ ɪz ˈfæstər/
dialogue.zh: 現在也能刷卡，不過現金快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Funny, my last market stop said exactly that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʌni maɪ læst ˈmɑːrkɪt stɑːp sɛd ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 真巧，上個攤位也是這樣講的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! We copy each other, it's true.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑː wi ˈkɑːpi ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðər ɪts truː/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我們都互相模仿，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything good. Can I get two extra cartons?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɡʊd kæn aɪ ɡɛt tuː ˈɛkstrə ˈkɑːrtənz/
dialogue.zh: 都好了。能再拿兩個空紙盒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For eggs or just collecting the boxes?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔːr ɛɡz ər dʒʌst kəˈlɛktɪŋ ðə ˈbɑːksəz/
dialogue.zh: 是裝蛋用，還是單純收藏盒子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neighbor asked, might be me, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈneɪbər æskt maɪt biː miː ˈɑːnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 鄰居拜託的，也可能是我自己想要，嘿嘿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Here you go, have a great week!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑː hɪr ju ɡoʊ hæv ə ɡreɪt wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，拿去啦，祝你這週愉快！
